boards.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create a professional high-resolution product design blueprint image for ConstructClaim, a construction progress-claim and certification PWA. This is board 01 of a coherent four-board UI/UX visual SSOT, named "01 / Workspace & navigation". Wide landscape canvas, approximately 2560 x 1600 or the highest practical resolution. Flat orthographic interface artboards, no laptop or phone hardware, no perspective, no photographs, no marketing illustration. High-fidelity wireframe: realistic implementable SaaS UI with restrained color, clear hierarchy, crisp large readable English typography, precise grid alignment. It should look like a senior product designer's polished Figma handoff board, not a poster.

Visual system: background #F4F7FB, white surfaces, ink #14243B, secondary #52637A, primary blue #155EEF, border #D9E2EE, tiny orange brand accent #F79009. Calm professional construction finance identity. Inter-like sans serif, tabular numerals, thin consistent outline icons, 8px spacing rhythm, restrained 8-12px corners, almost no shadow, no gradients. Blue for actions/selection, amber for attention, green only confirmed success. No rainbow metric tiles. Every state has a text label.

Composition: slim header at top reading "ConstructClaim" then "UI Blueprint v2" and right aligned "01 / Workspace & navigation". Small subtitle "Target product design • Synthetic examples". Beneath, one dominant desktop artboard on the left about 72% of width, one tall mobile artboard on the right about 24%. Artboards are large enough for legible text, generous external gutters. Small footer annotation strip outside the apps, not consuming UI space.

DESKTOP ARTBOARD, realistic 1440px-class viewport:
240px-equivalent plain white left sidebar. Simple blue/orange geometric building mark and ConstructClaim wordmark. Nav items exactly: Overview (selected), Projects, Claims, Inbox, Parties, Reports. Settings anchored at bottom. No decorative building banner.
64px-equivalent utility bar: organization "Atlas Construction", search field "Search projects, claims, documents", subtle bell, circular initials "AL", compact sync status "Up to date".
Content header "Overview", subtitle "Your work across assigned projects", one primary button "+ New claim".
Top priority is a large section "My work" with two compact actionable rows: "Review claim PCAR-024" / "Harbor Exchange · Due today" / "Review"; "Add site evidence" / "Cedar Station · 2 items missing" / "Open".
Adjacent narrower "Continue draft" card: "Cedar Station", "Payable · Oct 2026", "Saved on this device", blue outline "Resume draft". Human-readable reference DRAFT-018 in muted small type, never a UUID.
Below, section header "Financial position" with clearly selected "Receivable" segmented tab and unselected "Payable", period "Oct 2026", currency "SGD · illustrative". Four slim metric cells labelled exactly "Claimed" "Certified" "Invoiced" "Paid" with amounts 120,000; 100,000; 90,000; 60,000. Beneath these cells one short caption "Separate financial stages — do not add together". No donut/pie chart, no combined total, no misleading green upward trend.
Bottom section "Recent projects": compact table columns "Project", "Next action", "Updated". Two rows Harbor Exchange / Review claim / Today and Cedar Station / Resume draft / Today. Clear row chevrons, slim row dividers, no decorative imagery.

MOBILE ARTBOARD, 390px-class:
Compact top bar ConstructClaim, bell, small connectivity icon with "Online".
Heading "My work" with small "Atlas Construction".
Two compact task rows as on desktop, followed by one visible compact "Continue draft" card Cedar Station / Payable · Oct 2026 / "Resume".
Then "Financial position", Receivable / Payable segmented switch, two-by-two compact amount cells using same four separate labels and figures; understated currency "SGD · illustrative".
One "Recent projects" row if room. Avoid stacking oversized KPI cards ahead of tasks.
Fixed bottom nav exact order Home (selected), Projects, Claims, Inbox, More. Text with consistent outline icons. Adequate bottom safe-area spacing, no overlapping content.

Footer annotation outside artboards, succinct three notes: "Task-first home" / "Tablet: collapse navigation before content crowds" / "Mobile: 44px touch targets, visible text states".
Preserve a balanced useful amount of whitespace. No fake backend success promises, no security slogans, no undefined Claim Gap, no extra screens. Readable exact short copy, crisp UI, understated professional finish.

Use case: ui-mockup.
Generate a NEW matching professional UI/UX blueprint for ConstructClaim. Image 1 is a STYLE AND SHELL REFERENCE ONLY, not an edit target. Match its typography, visual scale, thin icon style, blue/white/navy palette, border radii, restrained spacing and flat artboard presentation exactly. This new board is "02 / Claims & draft editing" in the same four-board UI Blueprint v2. Wide landscape, highest practical sharp resolution. No devices, perspective, stock photography, gradients, decorative crane images or tiny illegible filler. All text in English. Header exactly "ConstructClaim | UI Blueprint v2" and "02 / Claims & draft editing"; subheading "Target product design • Synthetic examples".

Composition: a dominant desktop claim editor artboard on the left, a tall mobile equivalent on the right, and a shallow design-annotation strip across the bottom. Same relative sizing as reference. Do NOT reproduce the dashboard. Make practical fields and action hierarchy the focus. Keep essential form fields near the top, with no verbose warning banners.

DESKTOP:
Use same white sidebar and utility bar as reference. Sidebar items Overview, Projects, Claims (selected), Inbox, Parties, Reports, bottom Settings. Top organization Atlas Construction, global search, small "Online" connection indicator, AL avatar.
In content area a compact breadcrumb "Projects / Cedar Station / Claims".
Title "New payable claim" with small pill "Draft". Smaller subtitle "Cedar Station · Subcontract SC-014 · Oct 2026". Muted readable reference "DRAFT-018" at upper right, never a UUID.
One narrow four-step progress header: "1 Details" complete, "2 Claim lines" active, "3 Evidence", "4 Review".
Below, left approximately 70% of content is a claim-lines table. Header "Claim lines" with short secondary button "+ Add line". Columns "Item", "Previous", "This period", "Cumulative", "Evidence". Two rows: "A01 · Site preparation" with 20,000 / editable 10,000 / 30,000 / "2 files"; "A02 · Concrete works" with 30,000 / editable 15,000 / 45,000 / "1 file". Footer current total 25,000. Clear right aligned currency numbers, "SGD · illustrative" above table.
Below table is a compact note field "Period notes" with text "Progress measured for October." and a helper "Your project stays selected throughout this draft."
Right content column "Draft summary": project Cedar Station, direction Payable, period Oct 2026; "Claimed this period" 25,000, "Previously claimed" 50,000, "Cumulative claimed" 75,000. "Certification" shown "Not yet certified", NEVER zero or certified sum. Compact evidence checklist "3 files attached", "Review evidence before submission".
Bottom action bar within content and clear of fields: left text with check icon "Saved on this device · Not submitted"; secondary "Save draft"; one blue primary "Continue to evidence". A subtle link "Back to details". No approval or issue button in a claim draft.
Show one small secondary text link "View all claims" near breadcrumb.

MOBILE:
Same compact brand bar. Compact text back link "Claims", project context "Cedar Station · Payable" directly underneath. Title "Edit claim line". Small "Draft · Oct 2026". Step progress compact "2 of 4 · Claim lines". Compact line selector "A02 · Concrete works" and "Line 2 of 2", with previous/next chevrons.
Large accessible input label "This period (SGD)" and value "15,000.00".
Two small read-only summary cells "Previous" 30,000 and "Cumulative" 45,000.
Label "Progress note", short multiline field "Concrete works measured on site.".
Evidence row with outline file icon "1 file attached" and text action "Add evidence".
One slim amber connectivity line "Offline · Saved on this device". This describes target behavior after a successful local transaction, not server acceptance.
Persistent bottom action area INSIDE artboard: "Save line" as blue full-width button, secondary back text if room, small text "Not submitted". In this focused editor, omit global bottom navigation to keep a clear safe-area action bar; retain the explicit back-to-Claims link. Button does not overlap fields.
Make all controls comfortably touchable and body text readable.

Footer notes outside artboards: "Keep project and direction in context" / "Preserve input during network changes" / "Claims list: Receivable and Payable filters never mix directions". Add a tiny simple claims-list component sketch if space permits, with header "Receivable" and ONLY PCAR-024 / PCAR-025 rows, separate Claimed and Certified columns; show an em dash with "Not certified" instead of a made-up zero.
Prioritize readable form layouts over fitting extra panels. Every amount is synthetic. No claim of real synchronization. Preserve visual consistency with Image 1.
corrections: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this ConstructClaim UI Blueprint v2 board with exactly ONE consistency correction. In the MOBILE artboard at the upper right, the top utility bar currently has a green dot followed by "Online". Change ONLY that mobile top-bar status to an AMBER dot followed by "Offline", matching the existing amber "Offline · Saved on this device" status lower in the same mobile artboard. The DESKTOP artboard must keep its green "Online" status unchanged. Preserve every other pixel-level layout, title, field, value, icon, text, color, table, note, screen dimensions and typography as closely as possible. Do not remove or add any screen, do not redesign anything. English copy exact: "Offline".

boards.prompt:

Slim ConstructClaim | UI Blueprint v2 header and subtitle "Target product design • Synthetic examples". White and pale gray surfaces, dark navy text, restrained primary blue, thin consistent icons, no gradients or decorative photos. No device hardware or perspective.

Layout: dominant desktop certification workspace left, one tall mobile evidence-capture artboard right. Small footer callouts outside the apps. Both are target workflows, not current implementation screenshots.

DESKTOP:
Match standard left navigation Overview, Projects, Claims selected, Inbox, Parties, Reports, bottom Settings. Compact Atlas Construction search utility bar and Online status.
Breadcrumb "Claims / Receivable / Certification".
Heading "Review certificate", small state chip "Draft". Context line "Harbor Exchange · Oct 2026". Source reference prominent "Source claim PCAR-026 · Version 3". Certificate reference "CCAR-026 · Draft".
Clear local tab row "Claim" / "Certification" selected / "Evidence" / "History". These are separately owned linked records, not a combined editable status dropdown.

Main section "Line assessment", currency label "SGD · illustrative". Table columns "Item", "Claimed", "Certified", "Variance", "Reason". Row 1 "Foundation" / 60,000 / 60,000 / 0 / em dash. Row 2 "Concrete" / 40,000 / editable 35,000 / -5,000 in restrained red / "Measurement pending". Total row 100,000 / 95,000 / -5,000. Under summary a readiness checklist "Claim version linked" / "Variance reason supplied" / "Review evidence". No misleading all-green final issuance.

boards.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Generate a NEW ConstructClaim UI Blueprint v2 board. Image 1 is STYLE AND SHELL REFERENCE ONLY. Match its clean white/navy/blue professional enterprise design, outline icons, font sizes, generous field sizing, flat screen artboards, no hardware frames, no perspective, no gradient, no decorative construction photography. Wide landscape, highest practical sharp resolution. Top header "ConstructClaim | UI Blueprint v2", right "04 / Offline recovery & UI states". Small subtitle "Target product design • Synthetic examples".

Composition: dominant desktop artboard left at same scale as reference, a tall mobile artboard right, concise bottom handoff notes. This is a target recovery workflow, not a claim of current functionality. Show clear text states and exactly consistent connectivity indicators.

DESKTOP:
Standard sidebar Overview, Projects, Claims, Inbox, Parties, Reports, bottom Settings selected. Compact top utility bar organization Atlas Construction, search, green dot "Online", AL avatar.
Breadcrumb "Settings / Device data / Sync".
Title "Sync center". Subtitle "Review work saved on this device".
Compact informative blue banner "Connected · Review required" with supporting text "One conflict needs your decision. Local changes are preserved."
Three small inline summary counters, not oversized tiles: "Pending 2", "Conflict 1", "Failed 1". A short small-text line "Server-confirmed at 09:15" with clock icon. Counters must exactly match four table rows.
Main table "Device work", columns "Item", "Project", "State", "Action".
4 rows:
"Draft PCAP-018" / "Cedar Station" / amber "Pending" / "Open";
"Site photo 01" / "Cedar Station" / amber "Pending" / "View";
"Claim line A02" / "Cedar Station" / purple text "Conflict" / blue text "Review";
"Inspection PDF" / "Harbor Exchange" / red text "Failed" / "Retry".
Below list show a selected conflict region "Claim line A02 · Compare changes". Compact context "PCAP-018 · Base v3 / Server v4". A three-column comparison table with header "Field", "This device", "Server". Only two rows: "This period" / 15,000 / 12,000; "Note" / "Site measured" / "QS adjusted". Different fields highlighted subtly, not only by color.
Footer of conflict area "Nothing has been applied." action "Review resolution" primary. Do not create an automatic overwrite button or claim offline authoritative approval.
Small calm note below "Saved locally does not mean submitted." No promise of permanent storage or encrypted safe area.

MOBILE:
Top brand bar green dot "Online"; back link "Sync center".
Title "Resolve conflict".
Context "Cedar Station · PCAP-018 · A02".
Small amber notice "Review required" and text "Both versions are preserved."
Crucial mobile comparison is grouped BY FIELD rather than two huge whole-record cards. First bordered section label "This period (SGD)" and short two-column rows "This device · v3" 15,000 and "Server · v4" 12,000. Second section label "Note" then "This device: Site measured" and "Server: QS adjusted".
Section "Choose a resolution". Three full-width accessible radio options, NONE selected: "Keep server values", "Review my changes", "Edit and merge". Exact short explanation under "Review my changes": "Check before sending". Under Keep server values: "Discard this local edit". Under Edit and merge: "Prepare a revised draft".
Bottom area includes small text "No changes applied", secondary "Cancel", visibly disabled primary "Review resolution". The button remains disabled until a choice; final application always requires a separate explicit confirmation and server revalidation. No global bottom nav in this focused task; explicit back link.
Comfortable hit areas and safe area, keep all text legible.

Outside apps, BOTTOM COMPONENT STRIP, compact professional handoff rather than another screen:
small labelled UI-state chips "Saving" "Saved on device" "Pending" "Synced" "Conflict" "Failed"; text footnote "Synced requires server confirmation".
Optional tiny state tiles if space allows: "No claims yet" with "New claim"; "No results" with "Clear filters"; "Upload failed" with "Retry". Do not squeeze or shrink main screens to add them.
Footer short design notes "Confirm before applying" / "Never silently overwrite" / "Use one consistent status vocabulary".
The image should communicate safe recoverable workflows through layout, not long policy text. Be precise with spelling. No invented financial metrics.
